review_scope: Independent frozen H08/H12 source review and canonical recompilation; no sources changed or candidates added.
source_findings: No concrete behavior-changing defect found relative to the clean C under its documented source-defined domain.

H08 real success-default setter results preserve no-voice skip, callback count and arguments, FP expression order, clamp and narrowing. H12 explicit callback diamonds likewise map any nonzero callback result to failure.

Early-cancel, normal-success and retry-exhaustion recycling preserve remove-before-insert calls; next was captured before callbacks, free-list first is read after removal, and reaching the loop update after retry-local recycling replaces the original continue without intervening work.

Both retain command order, sentinel short-circuiting, later node entry and parameter reloads, table-base and table-size reloads across callbacks, retry byte increment, and kind-zero exhaustion exemption.
H12 retains only stable addresses of actual globals: pending and free lists plus completed-history slot; callback-mutable contents remain read at their original sites.
Declarations, layouts, exported MP_TargetSteerPos and stop_entry are unchanged. No fake callers, keepers, volatile pressure, padding, register binding or ABI alteration.
limits: 2048 unchanged host-C scenarios are baseline-relative, not target/native/O32 or complete-equivalence proof.
The harness initializes retries only in 0..11 and does not exercise 255-to-0 wrap; wrapping is preserved by unchanged source increment, not demonstrated by the test.

Callback mutations are bounded to table-base and node-entry reassignment; mutable value/stream/priority/route, dynamic count changes, arbitrary aliasing, concurrency and FP/FCSR exceptions are not exhaustively tested.
No exact match or authentic out-of-line helper ABI recovery is established.
